name: Narset's Reversal

abilities.text: Copy target instant or sorcery spell, then return it to its owner's hand. You may choose new targets for the copy.

notes: One target, used twice: `copy-spell` declares the only target spec and the `bounce` reads it back as `target:0` (a `stack` TargetRef resolves to the spell's card, composition core §1), so the card asks for one target rather than two.

issues: ...then return it to its owner's hand. — expected the targeted spell is returned, not countered; a spell with "can't be countered" is still returnable — scripted the bounce path sets it.countered = true on the spell item (game.ts:1320). The zone move is right (moveTo hand, owner-based) and bounce never checks cant-be-countered, so behavior is correct, but the flag would feed any "whenever a spell is countered" trigger and mislabels the event. — CR 701.10a / 707.10

You may choose new targets for the copy. — expected the copy may be re-aimed (the card's whole point — steal an opponent's spell) — scripted newTargets: true declared, but the engine never implements it (no `newTargets` reference outside schema/render/types). Copy keeps the original targets. — CR 707.10c

Copy target instant or sorcery spell, then return it... — expected exactly one target, used by both clauses, and the copy made before the original leaves the stack — scripted copy-spell declares target 0 and bounce reads it back as `target:0`; effect order is copy-then-bounce. Verified correct — the notes claim holds, and bounce has an explicit branch for a Ref that resolved to a stack spell's card. — CR 707.10

You may choose new targets for the copy. — expected the copy's targets may be changed — scripted newTargets: true is never read by the engine (same gap as Dualcaster); the copy inherits orig.targets verbatim. — CR 707.10

then return it to its owner's hand — expected the spell is removed from the stack and put into its OWNER's hand; it is NOT countered — scripted bounce (game.ts:1321) sets it.countered = true on the removed StackItem before moving the card. Zone-wise correct (moveTo 'hand'), but the countered flag could wrongly satisfy 'whenever a spell is countered' style checks. Engine-level, not a script-authoring error. — CR 701.5a

Copy target instant or sorcery spell, then return it... — expected exactly one target, and the copy is created before the original leaves the stack — scripted copy-spell declares the only TargetSpec and bounce reads it back as target:0 — correct ordering and single-target; the engine explicitly names this pattern in the bounce comment (game.ts:1316-1318). — CR 707.10
